request: Add cylindrical heads on the long pins to prevent link arms against slipping off.

actions.operation: Add cylindrical head feature(s) to pin(s) (e.g., add a cylindrical boss/cap at an end of each long pin).

parameters.apply_to_ends: both ends (posZ and negZ end caps)
parameters.head_outer_diameter: TBD (must be larger than link end boss OD to act as a retainer, but small enough to avoid interference during scissor motion)
parameters.head_axial_thickness: TBD (small, enough to retain; keep consistent across all pins)
parameters.head_edge_treatment: TBD (small fillet or chamfer on head outer edge for manufacturability)
parameters.head_concentricity: concentric to existing pin shank axis

actions.relational_constraint: Create outboard retaining collars (cylindrical heads) concentric with each corner pivot pin shank, located on the external sides of the linkage stacks at both Z extremes, so the scissor link arms cannot translate off the pins in Z.
actions.unresolved_reference: Exact head diameter and thickness are not specified; choose values based on required retention margin over link boss OD and required clearance to plate edges/slot travel.
steps: Identify the 'long pins' as the four corner pivot pins in SEC_05 (they are the only pins described as extending across the full Z depth with end caps at both Z extremes). Do not modify the central pivot spacer/pin set (SEC_06) because those are short spacers and not the primary retention risk for link arms slipping off in Z.

For the lower-right corner pin: use end-cap face Pin_LR_endCap_negZ (face_code 0062, Brep_id FACE 31) as the sketch plane. Start a 2D sketch on this planar face; project/convert the circular edge of the pin shank to capture the pin axis/center. Draw a concentric circle with diameter = head_outer_diameter. Constrain concentric to the pin shank circle.

Extrude (Join/Add) the sketched circle outward in the -Z direction (normal to the end-cap face) by head_axial_thickness to form the first cylindrical head/collar. Apply head_edge_treatment (small fillet or chamfer) on the outer circular rim edges of the new head to remove sharp edges.

Repeat on the opposite end-cap face Pin_LR_endCap_posZ (face_code 0063, Brep_id FACE 33): sketch concentric circle (same head_outer_diameter) and extrude (Join/Add) outward in the +Z direction by head_axial_thickness; apply the same edge treatment.

Repeat the same two-ended head creation for the lower-left corner pin using end-cap faces Pin_LL_endCap_negZ (face_code 0065, Brep_id FACE 39) and Pin_LL_endCap_posZ (face_code 0066, Brep_id FACE 41). Ensure both heads remain concentric with the pin shank (face_code 0064).

Repeat the same two-ended head creation for the upper-right corner pin using end-cap faces Pin_UR_endCap_negZ (face_code 0068, Brep_id FACE 122) and Pin_UR_endCap_posZ (face_code 0069, Brep_id FACE 124). Ensure both heads remain concentric with the pin shank (face_code 0067).

Repeat the same two-ended head creation for the upper-left corner pin using end-cap faces Pin_UL_endCap_negZ (face_code 0071, Brep_id FACE 127) and Pin_UL_endCap_posZ (face_code 0072, Brep_id FACE 129). Ensure both heads remain concentric with the pin shank (face_code 0070).

Functional clearance check (kinematic intent): verify that, through the slot-guided motion (SEC_01/SEC_02 slots guiding SEC_05 pins), the new head OD does not collide with the outer faces of the scissor link plates on +Z (SEC_03 outer faces, e.g., face_code 0022/0032) or -Z (SEC_04 outer faces, e.g., face_code 0041/0051), nor with plate outer faces/edges. If interference occurs, reduce head_outer_diameter and/or head_axial_thickness or consider adding a shallow counterbore/relief in the link outer boss area instead (not requested, only as fallback).
Pattern/consistency: keep head parameters identical for all four corner pins to maintain symmetry about Z=0 and consistent retention behavior on both scissor linkages.

intention: Prevent link arms from slipping off the long pins by adding retaining head geometry.
